rows.sourceTitle: Early risk of stroke after transient ischemic attack: a systematic review and meta-analysis
rows.guard: Require a documented TIA, a separately established later cerebrovascular accident with objective residuals, and compatible chronology; the evidence does not establish that any individual's later stroke or residuals were caused by the TIA. Preserve vascular risk factors and other stroke causes. Do not infer stroke residuals from a TIA history alone.

rows.sourceTitle: Factors Predicting Testicular Atrophy after Testicular Salvage following Torsion
rows.guard: Require documented testicular torsion, separately documented later ipsilateral testicular atrophy or objective volume loss, and compatible chronology; the cohort does not establish that every individual's atrophy was caused by torsion. Preserve ischemia duration, treatment, infection, trauma, cryptorchidism, congenital hypoplasia, and other causes.

rows.sourceTitle: The risk of developing squamous cell carcinoma in patients with anogenital lichen sclerosis: A systematic review
rows.guard: Restrict to biopsy-documented anogenital lichen sclerosus, separately established anogenital squamous-cell carcinoma, and compatible chronology; do not generalize the review to extragenital disease or infer carcinoma from appearance or dysplasia alone.

rows.sourceTitle: Chronic Rhinosinusitis with Nasal Polyps and Asthma
rows.guard: Require documented chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, separately established asthma by appropriate pulmonary criteria, and compatible chronology; the review does not establish that nasal polyps caused or aggravated an individual's asthma. Preserve allergic, aspirin-related, occupational, smoking, obesity, reflux, medication, and other respiratory contributors.

Preserve medication, surgical, neurologic, endocrine, obstructive, functional, and idiopathic alternatives.
